create_video_system: create a VideoSystem instance with an output directory and verbose logging enabled
save_outputs_as_images: save model outputs as individual RGB, depth, and normal image files to disk
save_outputs_as_video: save model outputs as encoded MP4 video files using H.264 codec and configurable FPS
save_gaussians: save 4D Gaussian parameters including xyz, feature, opacity, scaling, and rotation to an NPZ file
load_gaussians: load previously saved 4D Gaussian parameters from an NPZ file by batch index
